title: Kuudra Follower Armor
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Armor |rarity = s |salable = n |auctionable = n |tradeable = n |soulbound = Solo |color = 35530A |all_colors_the_same = true |helmet_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_HELMET |chestplate_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_CHESTPLATE |leggings_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_LEGGINGS |boots_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_BOOTS }} '''Kuudra Follower Armor''' is a {{Special}} [[Armor]] set. == Obtaining == === Helmet === {{See also|Kuudra Believer|Wet Napkin|Plhlegblast}} To obtain the Kuudra Follower Helmet, the player must have obtained the {{Item|Wet Napkin}} on their own, which can be fished up by following these steps: * Donate at least {{c|1m}} to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}} and complete a [[Kuudra]] boss fight within the next 30 minutes. The {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}} will then appear at {{Coords|-131|93|-177}} in the {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}. * Complete the {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}}'s dialogue. * Use a lava fishing rod near the {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}} with {{Item|Ice Bait}}, while wearing a full {{Item|Elegant Tuxedo}} and a {{Item|Bonzo's Mask}} with {{Ench|Respiration I}}. In addition to the prerequisite above, a {{MobSprite|Plhlegblast}} must be within {{Green|3}} blocks of the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}}. Once all these requirements are met, the player can claim the Kuudra Follower Helmet by donating the number of {{coins}} given by the formula below to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}}. The number of {{coins}} is always in the range of {{c|13331070|13599850}}.
\text{Number of Coins} = 13331996 + 2\cdot\left(\text{Day of the Year in EST}\right)^2 - 58\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right)
''Day of the Year in EST'' is the number of days since the last New Year's Eve, in the [[w:UTC−05:00|UTC−05:00]] time zone (Eastern Standard Time, with no change for daylight saving time). For example, it would be 8 on January 8, or 44 on February 13. For {{#time:F j, Y|-5 hours}}, the number is {{#expr:{{#time:z|-5 hours}}+1}}.
''Player Name Length'' is the number of characters in the player's Minecraft player name. ==== Calculator ==== {{:Calculator:Kuudra Follower Helmet}} {{Coll S B|id=formula-explanation|name=Show/Hide Explanation of Formula}} {{Coll S| * The hint was from the tooltip of [[Wet Napkin]], which reads: "''The total {{Mctxt|k|--------}} plus time times time, all that subtracted from thrice the commencement, then add {{Mctxt|k|--}} of yourself, the whole thing elbuod.''" * ''The total {{Mctxt|k|--------}}'' means the total number of Netherrack blocks in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}, which is 21408112. * ''time times time'' means to multiply the current day of the year by itself. This uses Eastern Standard Time, the time zone of Hypixel's server. * ''thrice the commencement'' means three times the thread ID of the Crimson Isle release patch notes (https://hypixel.net/threads/4914038/), which is 4914038. Three times this is 14742114. * ''{{Mctxt|k|--}} of yourself'' means 29 times the number of characters in the Minecraft player name of the player claiming the helmet. The 29 comes from the number of hidden [[fandom:among-us:Among Us|''Among Us'']] characters scattered throughout the map art of the [[Wet Napkin]]. * ''the whole thing elbuod'' means to multiply the result by -2, since ''elbuod'' is the word ''double'' backwards. * Combining all of this, we get -2\cdot\left(3\cdot\left(4914038\right) - \left(21408112+\left(\text{Day of the Year in EST}\right)^2\right) + 29\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right)\right). * This simplifies to 13331996 + 2\cdot\left(\text{Day of the Year in EST}\right)^2 - 58\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right). |id=formula-explanation}} === Chestplate === {{See also|Arch}} To obtain the Kuudra Follower Chestplate, at least 6 players are needed. These 6 players must be wearing {{Item|Ember Armor}} or {{Item|Rekindled Ember Armor}} and have a level 81 or higher {{Item|Kuudra Pet}} summoned. They must stand in pairs in the following locations. * 2 in the {{Zone|Stronghold}}. * 2 in the {{Zone|Dragontail Townsquare}}. * 2 in the {{Zone|Scarleton Plaza}}. The two players standing in the {{zone|Stronghold}}, as well as all other players on the server, can then speak to {{NPCSprite|Arch}} to claim the chestplate. === Leggings === {{See also|Kuudra Archeologist|Kuudra Relic}} The Kuudra Follower Leggings can be obtained by following these steps: * Click the bookshelf at {{coordinates|10|127|-938}} in the {{zone|Cathedral}} while having at least {{stat|int|4000}}. The following chat message will appear: {{Dialogue|&aYou use your mana to pull a book out. Most of it is unreadable but you do notice a 2 and a 22...}} In addition to the prerequisite above, click the block at {{coordinates|-373|82|-880}} inside the {{zone|Blazing Volcano}} while holding a [[Drill]] during a {{Volcano Activity|Cataclysmic}} volcano eruption. A menu will open, allowing the player to claim the {{Item|Kuudra Relic}}. Show the [[Kuudra Relic]] to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Archeologist}} to claim the Kuudra Follower Leggings. === Boots === {{See also|Kuudra Loremaster}} The Kuudra Follower Boots can be obtained by following these steps: * Type one of the following lines in chat near the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Loremaster}} in the {{zone|Scarleton}}: ** ''THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!'' ** ''Those orbs strengthen Kuudra! Shoot them down with your cannons!'' ** ''A Dropship! Take it down before it's too late!'' In addition to the prerequisite above, travel to the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} on Tuesdays and cross the void to the old {{zone|Blazing Fortress}}. The [[Kuudra Loremaster]] will appear at {{coordinates|-256.5|146|120.5}}. The player will be able to claim the Kuudra Follower Boots if the following requirements are met: * The player must have {{Item|Enchanted Magma Cream|amount=1024}} and {{Item|Enchanted Netherrack|amount=1024}} in their inventory. * The player must have at least {{Green|1,000,000}} collection in both {{Coll|Netherrack}} and {{Coll|Magma Cream}}. == Usage == {{See also|Drakuu}} Wearing the full set of '''Kuudra Follower Armor''' during a {{VA|cataclysmic}} eruption allows the player to purchase the {{Item|Kuudra Follower Artifact}} from {{NPCSprite|Drakuu}}. Additionally, wearing the full set while holding a {{Item|Golden Ball}} allows the player to exchange it with {{NPCSprite|Drakuu}} for a {{Item|Exquisite Kuudra Teeth Plaque}}. == Tips == *{{MobSprite|Plhlegblast}} quickly dies in lava since it is not immune to lava damage. A {{Item|Lead}} can be used to move it. *{{MobSprite|Plhlegblast}} takes suffocation damage when outside of water. A {{PotN|Water Breathing 6}} Splash Potion can be used to keep it alive in the air, as it completely prevents suffocation damage. *The current faction of a helper for the {{ID|Kuudra Follower Chestplate{{!}}Chestplate}} is irrelevant. * Wearing [[Bat Person Armor]] with [[Reforging#Necrotic|Necrotic reforge]] during [[Spooky Festival]] is a budget way to effectively raise {{stat|int}}. The '''Sighted''' accessory power can also help reach the high intelligence requirement. *Using {{Item|Bat Person Talisman}}'s {{ability}} combining with {{Item|Spirit Sceptre}} can raise {{stat|int}} a little for several seconds, useful for when [[armor]], [[equipment]], and [[Accessory Power]] are still incapable to reach {{stat|int|4000}}. *Contributions from [[Co-op]] members count toward the collection requirements for the boots. == Trivia == * Kuudra Follower Armor is the only obtainable {{Special}} armor set. *Of all pieces, the {{ID|Kuudra Follower Chestplate{{!}}Chestplate}} is the easiest to obtain - the player to claim the piece doesn't require anything other than talking to Arch as long as there are 6 players helping, while other pieces require the player completing certain tasks on their own. * The lines for obtaining Kuudra Follower Boots were removed as it was the lines before the Kuudra fight revamp. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Kuudra Follower Armor'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Kuudra Follower Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Kuudra Follower Armor'''.}} {{History|2022/May 29|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Leggings.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Leggings''' are discovered.}} {{History|2022/June 28|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Boots.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Boots''' are discovered.}} {{History|2022/Sep 12|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Chestplate.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Chestplate''' is discovered.}} {{History|2022/Dec 18|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Helmet.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Helmet''' is discovered.}} {{History|0.17.2|Questline of {{Item|Kuudra Follower Leggings}} can now be advanced by any [[drill]] rather than only {{Item|Divan's Drill}}.|Reduced the amounts of collection required for {{Item|Kuudra Follower Boots}} from {{Green|5,000,000}} to {{Green|1,000,000}}.}} {{History|0.18.4|This quest can now be completed even if the player is muted on the Hypixel Network.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Armors}}
